name: Clash's Glitch Per Difficulty Chart Obby
desc:
Welcome to Clash’s Glitch Per Difficulty Chart Obby! 👋

Take on 100 unique stages that gradually increase in difficulty as you progress. What starts off simple quickly becomes a real challenge. Do you have what it takes to reach the end? If you're struggling try watching the examples, as they give a short tutorial on how to complete each stage.

🎮 Every 25 stages, enjoy a fun activity to take a break and reset before the next challenge!

🔄 Press R to reset at any time.

⭐ Join the group for a FREE skip:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/865424261/Clashs-Obbies#!/about

👍 Enjoying the game? Don’t forget to leave a like!
